item.title: AWS Introduces Foreign Key Constraints in Aurora DSQL
item.description: AWS recently announced that Aurora DSQL now supports foreign key constraints, allowing applications to enforce referential integrity directly in the database, including CASCADE, SET NULL, and other referential actions. (1 source: infoq)
